name: Campbell's - Franklin WI
type: Manufacturing - tortilla chips (Late July; capacity expanded 2024)

fieldNotes.identity: Roster address 9999 S 60th St is incorrect; the Baptista's Bakery / Campbell Snacks tortilla-chip plant is at 4625 W Oakwood Park Dr in the Franklin Business Park. Locked the large white industrial building at 42.8594,-87.9863 - footprint measures ~205m x 114m (~252,000 sq ft, matches the ~250-300K sq ft reported plant size), has a curved-glass office wing at the NW corner and ~10 dock doors with trailers backed in on the SW face. 2019 Street View showed a 'Central' monument sign (likely a former tenant or office sub-tenant); building footprint, food-plant dock layout, and Franklin Business Park location all match the Campbell snacks plant - medium confidence on identity.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Both driveways from the road (NW truck/parking drive and NE office drive) are open paved entrances with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint. truckGate=false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at either driveway; office front and dock areas show no guard shack.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long N-S internal drive runs from the road down the W side past parking to the SW dock apron - holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~10 dock doors on the SW face (trailers backed in confirm) plus a small dock/material-handling apron at the SE corner; total estimated 12-14 -> 10-25 band. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 3-4 free-standing trailers parked near the SW dock apron without tractors - small drop area, 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A modest cluster of parked trailers exists adjacent to the SW dock apron; counted as a small on-site drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Main dock bank on SW face plus a separate small dock/staging apron on the SE corner - likely separate ship/receive clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two distinct driveways to the road (NW and NE) allow separate in/out routing.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Franklin WI is a suburb within the Milwaukee metro; the site sits in a dense business park - Urban.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated from SW apron + adjacent paved space; honest overhead estimate.
